forms.title: Recruitee careers site application (React, dotted field names, in-page success)
forms.confirmationText: Your application has been successfully submitted
quirks: react-hook-form dotted input names (candidate.openQuestionAnswers.<id>.content) differ from the bracketed multipart keys actually sent
radix ids containing dots and colons (CSS selectors must escape them)
phone input pre-filled with "+1" behind a downshift country-code listbox; typing +92 switches the country
file inputs stretched invisibly (opacity 0) over 'Upload a file or drag and drop here' areas
cover letter file/text toggle ('Write it here instead' / 'Clear and upload a cover letter instead')
open questions: boolean radios (true/false), single-choice radios valued by option text, multi-choice checkboxes (indexed multiContent), single-line, date, multi-line
GDPR agreement checkbox (required) + optional legal 'keep my data for future jobs' question (careful applicant leaves it unchecked)
fetch() multipart FormData (object-to-formdata, indices:true); success swaps tab panels in place, URL unchanged
forms.reference: Live <company>.recruitee.com/o/<slug>/c/new SSR markup, the public /api/offers/ JSON (open question kinds/options) and the careers-site main bundle (object-to-formdata submit, agreements), studied read-only
